result.quote: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
result.reason: Verse 9 says the young man fell from the third story and was picked up dead; verse 10 then describes Paul embracing him and declaring him alive. Thus the key’s summary that he fell, died, and was revived through Paul’s intervention is supported.
